# semaphore_ex_project_secret_storage (Resource)

Manages project secret storage and synchronization metadata without returning stored credential material.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) .
- `project_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i>.
- `type` (String) . Value must be one of : `local`, `vault`, `openbao`, `dvls`, `aws_sm`, `azure_kv`.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `params` (Dynamic)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) .
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) .
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) .
- `source_key` (String, Sensitive) .
- `source_type` (String) . Value must be one of : `env`, `file`.
- `sync_direction` (String) . Value must be one of : `read_only`, `outbound`.
- `sync_enabled` (Boolean) .
- `sync_interval` (Number) . Value must be at least 0.
- `sync_paths` (Attributes List) . (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_paths))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) .
- `read_only` (Boolean) .
- `sync_revision` (Number) .

<a id="nestedatt--sync_paths"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_paths`

Optional:

- `access_key_id` (Number) . Value must be at least 1.
- `field` (String) .
- `mount` (String) .
- `path` (String) .

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) .
- `remote_version` (Number) .

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
